# braidio

> Weave narration with extracted media segments into audiovisual productions


## Pages in this subsection

- [braidio](braidio.html.md): braidio — weave narration with extracted media segments into productions.
- [braidio.captions](braidio.captions.html.md): Subtitles for a rendered production, built from the script it was rendered from.
- [braidio.compose](braidio.compose.html.md): Config-driven narration composition (#20) — the reusable entrypoint.
- [braidio.conversation](braidio.conversation.html.md): Conversational register: render an exchange as people &#42;talking to each other&#42;.
- [braidio.cost](braidio.cost.html.md): Cost model for braidio’s paid operations (ElevenLabs TTS).
- [braidio.defaults](braidio.defaults.html.md): User-overridable, persisted defaults for how braidio renders a voice.
- [braidio.delivery](braidio.delivery.html.md): Narration &#42;delivery&#42; presets — model + voice settings (issue #10, expressiveness).
- [braidio.formats](braidio.formats.html.md): Ready-made &#42;&#42;format templates&#42;&#42; — high-quality presets under standard names.
- [braidio.kinds](braidio.kinds.html.md): Production kinds braidio defines. Pure (no optional deps).
- [braidio.multivoice](braidio.multivoice.html.md): Multi-voice narration: cycle a pool of voices across segments (issue #10).
- [braidio.music](braidio.music.html.md): Music bed — an instrumental underscore laid under the whole production, ducked.
- [braidio.pacing](braidio.pacing.html.md): Intra-beat narration pacing — how one narration beat becomes spoken &#42;turns&#42;.
- [braidio.relevance](braidio.relevance.html.md): How well a still relates to the words spoken over it — the scorer seam.
- [braidio.render](braidio.render.html.md): Render a &#96;Script&#96; into an audio file.
- [braidio.rights](braidio.rights.html.md): Render profiles: enforce personal-vs-published rights as data.
- [braidio.script](braidio.script.html.md): Composition model — the ordered beats a render walks.
- [braidio.sources](braidio.sources.html.md): Segment sources: resolve a &#42;reference&#42; to a cuttable &#96;&#91;start, end&#93;&#96; window.
- [braidio.structure](braidio.structure.html.md): Structural music — stings at scene breaks, fade-to-spotlight on exhibits.
- [braidio.style](braidio.style.html.md): Style audit — flag the recycled rhetorical tics in commentary text.
- [braidio.textprep](braidio.textprep.html.md): Text preparation for scripts — clean OCR’d source, tidy authored lines.
- [braidio.timeline](braidio.timeline.html.md): Timeline breakdown — what a production spends its time on, and in what order.
- [braidio.tts](braidio.tts.html.md): ElevenLabs narration synthesis.
- [braidio.video](braidio.video.html.md): Turn a rendered production into a Ken Burns film over still images.
- [braidio.voice_library](braidio.voice_library.html.md): Voice-pool sourcing and curation from the ElevenLabs shared Voice Library.
- [braidio.weave](braidio.weave.html.md): Weave narration + audio clips on a timeline (#21) — the reusable mix engine.
- [braidio.weave_config](braidio.weave_config.html.md): WeaveConfig — every editing choice for weaving narration + segments (#20).
